## At a glance

- **What is true now.** The Party holds the [[Harbormaster's Ledger of Vessen]] and knows the Compact drowned the city on purpose.
- **Cost.** One charge of the [[Ebb Lantern]], and the Party is now a target for [[Ilse Corran]].
- **Where.** The tally house in [[Reedholt]].
- **Reactions.** [[Nib Ashwater]] weeps quietly. [[Pell Rushlight]] is silent for the first time.

> [!narration] Closing image
> The tally house is quiet, and the sticks hang still on the roof. On the table lies a green book, open to a page marked with red cord. Nib reads the clerk's name aloud, once, and then folds his hands. Outside, the tide has come back and the channel is full. Far to the east, a low groan rolls across the marsh and fades, like a door held shut for a very long time.

## Play

### Payoffs

The Party has the ledger. The bell has stopped ringing. The names of the drowned are spoken aloud in Reedholt for the first time in 141 years, by Nib and by [[Odalys Ferro]].

### Reactions

- Nib wants the moot to hear the names at the next moot.
- Pell wants to know whether the ferry families will ever get an apology.
- [[Odalys Ferro]] wants to take the ledger to her order. She is not sure they deserve it.

### Rewards

- The [[Harbormaster's Ledger of Vessen]].
- The trust of the village moot and a standing offer of a boat from Pell.

### Stinger

A low groan comes from the east. Pell says it is the sound of Crookback Sluice under strain, and that he has heard it only twice in his life. See [[The Failing Sluice]].

## Threads

- [[The Silent Bell]] moves. The ledger is in Party hands and Sable is quiet. Whom to tell is open.
- [[Reedrunner Tithe]] escalates. Ilse's crew lost the ledger and will look for the Party.
- [[The Failing Sluice]] stays dormant, with the first sign of trouble.
- Next Session: decide who reads the ledger, and prepare for the Long Ebb.
